agent.finish_summary: Fixed MinIDMap.iteritems() in boltons/cacheutils.py which was yielding the internal weakref object instead of the integer ID for each key, causing TypeError when callers sorted/compared the collected ids ('< not supported between instances of weakref.ReferenceType'). Changed `self.mapping[k][1]` to `self.mapping[k][0]`. Also removed a leftover debug print() in _clean(). Verified behavior with a manual script; removed all scratch/repro files.
